verdict.rationale: The evidence documents background batch crawls of up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking, and a timeout mode that returns partial results with a completion marker. Neither is checkpointing or a way to resume a crashed crawl, so they count only as adjacent features. No documented capability exists to resume a deep crawl from a saved checkpoint.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can resume a crashed deep crawl from a saved checkpoint instead of restarting from scratch
